master.definition_en: Preeclampsia is a hypertensive disorder of pregnancy that is characterized by new-onset hypertension with proteinuria presenting after 20 weeks of gestation, and depending on mild or severe forms may initially present with severe headache, visual disturbances, and hyperreflexia.
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

aliases_zh: 妊娠期高血压疾病（重度）
curated.category: 妊娠期心血管与胎盘血管急症
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 1) 胎盘血管重铸障碍及抗血管生成因子（如sFlt-1）大量释放，导致母体全身小动脉痉挛、血管内皮损伤及多器官缺血; 2) 若未及时控制，数小时至数天内可急剧恶化为子痫全身大抽搐、脑出血、急性肺水肿、胎盘早剥、DIC及HELLP综合征（溶血、肝酶升高、血小板减少），直接危及母婴双生命; 3) 危险先兆包括血压骤升（≥160/110 mmHg）、剧烈头痛、视物模糊/黑矇、持续性右上腹或剑突下疼痛及尿量骤减。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 终止妊娠（娩出胎盘）是唯一针对病因的根治手段；在未足月需保胎争取胎儿成熟期间，可通过硫酸镁防抽搐和拉贝洛尔/硝苯地平等安全降压药稳定病情。部分重度患者产后48小时内仍存在子痫或脑血管意外风险，需严密监护；远期患者心血管疾病风险较常人翻倍，需长期随访。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO估算全球每年约7.6万名孕产妇及约50万名胎儿/新生儿死于子痫前期及相关妊娠期高血压疾病（WHO GHE将其合并计入孕产妇高血压疾病大类）

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 国家孕产妇死因监测中“妊娠期高血压疾病”位居前四位主要死因之一，但随着产科急救网络普及，总体孕产妇死亡率已降至15/10万以下
annual_deaths_china.source: 中华医学会妇产科学分会《妊娠期高血压疾病诊治指南》

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球妊娠人群发病率约 2%–8%（WHO，2023）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国孕妇子痫前期总体患病率约 3%–5%（多中心产科流行病学研究，2023）

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 1) 孕妇一旦出现血压≥160/110 mmHg、剧烈头痛、视物不清、上腹剧痛或抽搐，立即拨打120就近送往具备危重孕产妇救治中心的三甲医院; 2) 抽搐发作时立即侧卧防误吸、清理口腔分泌物并放置牙垫防舌咬伤，严禁强行按压肢体; 3) 院内一线急救立即静脉负荷量+维持量输注硫酸镁（防子痫抽搐首选，注意监测膝腱反射、呼吸与尿量），并予静脉拉贝洛尔、尼卡地平或乌拉地尔平稳降压（目标收缩压140–150 mmHg，避免血压骤降致胎盘灌注不足），评估后适时紧急终止妊娠。

standard_drugs.usage_role: 急性静脉降压及口服维持降压

non_drug_therapies_zh: 高危因素与家系排查：有子痫前期家族史（涉及STOX1、CORIN、FLT1等易感基因位点）、既往子痫前期史、慢性高血压或抗磷脂综合征者，孕早期行FMF联合筛查及sFlt-1/PlGF比值监测
居家每日早晚监测血压与体重变化，警惕短期体重骤增或下肢明显水肿
重度患者产后仍需在监护室密切观察至少48小时，并在产后6–12周及终生定期随访血压、血脂与肾功能
clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 规范产检及高危孕期口服小剂量阿司匹林+拉贝洛尔预防总费用约1,000–3,000元人民币；若进展为重度子痫前期或子痫需紧急剖宫产、ICU监护及早产儿NICU救治，母婴合计单次住院费用可达2万–10万元以上

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 2023–2024年子痫前期管理聚焦精准早筛与靶向清除：1) sFlt-1/PlGF比值（界值38）在PROGNOSIS Asia中国队列中证实可精准排除短期发病风险并已被FDA/NMPA批准用于风险分层; 2) 中国多中心APPEC随机对照研究（2023）证实高危孕妇每日100mg阿司匹林不增加产后出血风险，随后的AVERT多中心三臂试验正比较不同剂量阿司匹林及二甲双胍的预防效果; 3) 靶向沉默胎盘sFlt-1 mRNA的siRNA疗法（如CBP-4888）及体外sFlt-1血浆吸附柱已进入1/2期临床评估。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 尚无获批的特效药物能安全逆转已发生的胎盘血管病变而不需提前终止妊娠; 2) 晚发型子痫前期预测敏感度仍不足，需结合AI多模态超声与母血生物标志物动态预警; 3) 早产儿救治与母体器官保护之间的最佳分娩时机仍需更精准的个体化决策模型。

breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护

master.definition_en: Keratolytic winter erythema is a rare epidermal disease, characterized by recurrent centrifugal palmoplantar peeling and erythema presenting seasonal variation (cold weather). Skin lesions may spread to the dorsum of hands and feet and to the interdigital spaces. Lower legs, knees and thighs may also be involved. Episodes may be preceded by itch and hyperhidrosis. Skin biopsy reveals an epidermal spongiosis with clefting in the stratum corneum, followed by regrowth. Keratolytic winter erythema follows an autosomal dominant mode of transmission.

master.definition_en: Isotretinoin embryopathy is an association of malformations caused by the teratogenic effect of isotretinoin, an oral synthetic vitamin A derivative, which is used to treat severe recalcitrant cystic acne. Exposure to isotretinoin during the first trimester of pregnancy has been associated with an increased risk of spontaneous abortions and severe birth defects including serious craniofacial (microcephaly, asymmetric crying facies, microphthalmia, developmental abnormalities of the external ear, ocular hypertelorism), cardio vascular (conotruncal heart defects, aortic arch abnormalities), and central nervous system (hydrocephalus, microcephaly, lissencephaly, Dandy-Walker malformation, cognitive deficit) anomalies and thymic aplasia. Isoretinoin is contraindicated during pregnancy.

Additionally, finger/hand anomalies, short stature, microcephaly and slender build are frequently described.

master.definition_en: PENS syndrome is a rare, genetic, neurocutaneous syndrome characterized by the presence of randomly distributed, small, white to yellowish, multiple, rounded or irregular polycyclically-shaped, epidermal keratotic papules and plaques of ''gem-like'' appearance with a rough surface, typically located on the trunk and proximal limbs, associated with variable neurological abnormalities, including psychomotor delay, epilepsy, speech and language impairment and attention deficit-hyperactivity disorder. master.definition_en: A rare non-syndromic renal/urinary tract malformation characterized by the presence of more than two kidneys (up to five), each of which mostly has its own collecting system, vascular supply, and distinct encapsulated parenchyma. The additional kidney(s), smaller than native ones, mostly occurs ipsilateral and caudal to the left kidney and may be fused to the native kidneys. Patients are usually asymptomatic but they may present with symptoms such as pain, a palpable abdominal mass, fever and sometimes with urinary symptoms (such as urinary incontinence) when supernumerary kidneys occur with an ectopic ureter. Additional congenital abnormalities including horseshoe kidney malformation, ventricular septal defect, and cloacal abnormalities (such as urethral atresia, vaginal atresia, ectopic ureter implantation, imperforate anus, and duplication of urethra) may also be present in some patients.
